## What this case checks

Ensure loading succeeds for a degenerate but parseable line while making its zero-length invalidity explicit to validation logic.

## Risk types covered

- `degenerate_but_parseable`
- `invalid_measurement`
- `zero_length_geometry`

| `expect_valid_geometry` | no |

| `expected_epsg` | `4326` |
| `expected_geometry_types` | `LineString` |

## Notes

Zero-length LineString that parses successfully but is geometrically degenerate.
